sources.title: Teen Driver Education Package | Best Driving School
sources.section: Package details: 24 Hr Classroom + Driving Package
sources.evidence: The 24-Hour Classroom, 7-Hour Driving, and 7-Hour Observation Course in Texas is designed to provide potential drivers with the necessary knowledge and skills required to safely operate a motor vehicle. 24 Hours of Classroom Instruction: The classroom portion covers essential driving concepts, including: Texas traffic laws and regulations Road signs, signals, and pavement markings Defensive driving techniques Safe vehicle operation Driver responsibility and decision-making Hazard recognition and accident prevention Highway and city driving strategies Weather and road condition awareness Construction zones and work-area safety Risk management and safe driving habits 7 Hours of Behind-the-Wheel Driving Instruction Students receive hands-on driving experience with a certified instructor while practicing essential driving skills in real-world traffic situations. This training helps students develop confidence, improve vehicle control, and learn safe driving habits. 7 Hours of In-Car Observation The observation portion allows students to ride in the vehicle and observe other student drivers during their driving lessons. While not actively driving, students gain valuable insight by watching how different traffic situations are handled and how instructors provide guidance and feedback.

Teen Behind-the-Wheel Lessons | Best Driving School
sources.section: Package details: Behind the Wheel Only (7 & 7)
sources.evidence: Texas Teen Driver Education – Behind-the-Wheel Training (7 & 7 Program) The Texas Teen Driver Education Program includes 7 hours of behind-the-wheel driving instruction and 7 hours of in-car observation, which are required components of the teen licensing process. This training helps students develop essential driving skills, including: Driver awareness and alertness Defensive driving techniques Safe vehicle operation Understanding and following Texas traffic laws Responsible driving habits and self-discipline Professional and courteous driving behavior 7 Hours of Behind-the-Wheel Driving Instruction Students receive hands-on driving experience with a certified instructor while practicing essential driving skills in real-world traffic situations. This training helps students develop confidence, improve vehicle control, and learn safe driving habits. 7 Hours of In-Car Observation The observation portion allows students to ride in the vehicle and observe other student drivers during their driving lessons. While not actively driving, students gain valuable insight by watching how different traffic situations are handled and how instructors provide guidance and feedback. PLEASE NOTE: Student must have a valid Texas Learner License/Permit before beginning behind-the-wheel training. After enrollment, the driving schedule will be sent via email. For questions or enrollment assistance, please contact our office!
